  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const clamp01 = (v) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);
  const fmtInt = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
  const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const pad3 = (n) => String(n).padStart(3, '0').replace(/^0+(?=\d{3})/, '');
  const seedHex = (seed) => (seed >>> 0).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(8, '0');
  const seedGroups = (seed) => {
    const h = seedHex(seed);
    return h.slice(0, 4) + ' ' + h.slice(4);
  };
  const roman = (num) => {
    const map = [
      [1000, 'M'], [900, 'CM'], [500, 'D'], [400, 'CD'], [100, 'C'], [90, 'XC'],
      [50, 'L'], [40, 'XL'], [10, 'X'], [9, 'IX'], [5, 'V'], [4, 'IV'], [1, 'I']
    ];
    let n = num;
    let out = '';
    for (const [value, glyph] of map) {
      while (n >= value) { out += glyph; n -= value; }
    }
    return out;
  };
  const reducedMotion = () => window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ======================================================================
     WORLD RENDERER
     Reads the simulation, owns no ecology. Can draw to any canvas, which is
     how the final specimen thumbnail is made.
     ====================================================================== */

  class WorldRenderer {
    constructor(canvas, options = {}) {
      this.canvas = canvas;
      this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      this.snapshot = !!options.snapshot;
      this.w = 0;
      this.h = 0;
      this.dpr = 1;
      this.scale = 1;
      this.offX = 0;
      this.offY = 0;
      this.terrain = null;
      this.sim = null;
      this.pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, active: false };
      this.hover = null;
      this.trace = true;
      this.time = 0;
      this.plantCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      this.plantCanvas.width = GRID_W;
      this.plantCanvas.height = GRID_H;
      this.plantCtx = this.plantCanvas.getContext('2d');
      this.plantImage = this.plantCtx.createImageData(GRID_W, GRID_H);
      this.buildPalette();
      this.lastLens = null;
    }

    buildPalette() {
      this.palette = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        const t = i / 63;
        const r = Math.round(54 + 148 * Math.pow(t, 0.76));
        const g = Math.round(69 + 156 * Math.pow(t, 0.72));
        const b = Math.round(48 + 69 * Math.pow(t, 0.8));
        const a = Math.round(255 * (0.045 + 0.80 * Math.pow(t, 1.1)));
        this.palette.push([r, g, b, a]);
      }
    }

    setSim(sim) {
      this.sim = sim;
      this.resize();
      this.buildTerrain();
    }

    resize() {
      const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      const W = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
      const H = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
      if (this.canvas.width !== W || this.canvas.height !== H) {
        this.canvas.width = W;
        this.canvas.height = H;
      }
      this.dpr = dpr;
      this.w = rect.width;
      this.h = rect.height;
      this.scale = Math.min(this.w / GRID_W, this.h / GRID_H);
      this.offX = (this.w - GRID_W * this.scale) / 2;
      this.offY = (this.h - GRID_H * this.scale) / 2;
      if (this.sim) this.buildTerrain();
    }

    buildTerrain() {
      if (!this.w || !this.h) return;
      const dpr = this.dpr;
      const tc = document.createElement('canvas');
      tc.width = Math.round(this.w * dpr);
      tc.height = Math.round(this.h * dpr);
      const c = tc.getContext('2d');
      c.scale(dpr, dpr);
      const s = this.scale;
      const ox = this.offX;
      const oy = this.offY;

      // engraved survey lattice
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(195,165,111,0.045)';
      c.lineWidth = 0.6;
      for (let gx = 0; gx <= GRID_W; gx += 8) {
        const x = ox + gx * s;
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(x, oy);
        c.lineTo(x, oy + GRID_H * s);
        c.stroke();
      }
      for (let gy = 0; gy <= GRID_H; gy += 8) {
        const y = oy + gy * s;
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(ox, y);
        c.lineTo(ox + GRID_W * s, y);
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(195,165,111,0.09)';
      for (let gx = 0; gx <= GRID_W; gx += 16) {
        for (let gy = 0; gy <= GRID_H; gy += 16) {
          c.fillRect(ox + gx * s - 0.5, oy + gy * s - 0.5, 1.2, 1.2);
        }
      }

      // basalt outcrops
      const sim = this.sim;
      if (sim) {
        for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
          for (let x = 0; x < GRID_W; x++) {
            const i = y * GRID_W + x;
            if (!sim.refuge[i]) continue;
            const noise = ((x * 92821) ^ (y * 68917)) & 255;
            const alpha = 0.50 + (noise / 255) * 0.18;
            c.fillStyle = `rgba(13,24,21,${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
            c.fillRect(ox + x * s - 0.3, oy + y * s - 0.3, s + 0.6, s + 0.6);
          }
        }
        // stippled interiors
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(148,143,116,0.10)';
        for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
          for (let x = 0; x < GRID_W; x++) {
            if (!sim.refuge[y * GRID_W + x]) continue;
            if (((x * 7 + y * 13) & 7) !== 0) continue;
            c.fillRect(ox + x * s + s * 0.35, oy + y * s + s * 0.4, 0.9, 0.9);
          }
        }
        // contour lines: mark exposed edges
        c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(195,165,111,0.22)';
        c.lineWidth = 0.65;
        c.beginPath();
        for (let y = 0; y < GRID_H; y++) {
          for (let x = 0; x < GRID_W; x++) {
            const i = y * GRID_W + x;
            if (!sim.refuge[i]) continue;
            const px = ox + x * s;
            const py = oy + y * s;
            if (!sim.refuge[i - GRID_W]) { c.moveTo(px, py); c.lineTo(px + s, py); }
            if (!sim.refuge[i + GRID_W]) { c.moveTo(px, py + s); c.lineTo(px + s, py + s); }
            if (!sim.refuge[i - 1]) { c.moveTo(px, py); c.lineTo(px, py + s); }
            if (!sim.refuge[i + 1]) { c.moveTo(px + s, py); c.lineTo(px + s, py + s); }
          }
        }
        c.stroke();
      }

      this.terrain = tc;
    }

    paintPlants(sim) {
      const data = this.plantImage.data;
      const pal = this.palette;
      for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
        const p = sim.plants[i];
        const idx = p <= 0.008 ? 0 : Math.min(63, (p * 63) | 0);
        const c = pal[idx];
        const o = i * 4;
        data[o] = c[0];
        data[o + 1] = c[1];
        data[o + 2] = c[2];
        data[o + 3] = p <= 0.008 ? 0 : c[3];
      }
      this.plantCtx.putImageData(this.plantImage, 0, 0);
    }

    draw(sim, options = {}) {
      if (!this.w) this.resize();
      if (!this.w) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const w = this.w;
      const h = this.h;
      const s = this.scale;
      const ox = this.offX;
      const oy = this.offY;
      const dpr = this.dpr;

      if (!this.snapshot) this.trace = options.trace !== false;
      this.hover = options.hover || null;
      this.time = (this.time + 1) % 100000;

      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
      bg.addColorStop(0, '#0b1a15');
      bg.addColorStop(0.45, '#07130f');
      bg.addColorStop(1, '#050d0b');
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(w * 0.34, h * 0.06, 0, w * 0.34, h * 0.06, w * 0.8);
      glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(76,117,88,0.15)');
      glow.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(45,74,58,0.055)');
      glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

      this.paintPlants(sim);
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.98;
      ctx.drawImage(this.plantCanvas, 0, 0, GRID_W, GRID_H, ox, oy, GRID_W * s, GRID_H * s);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      // lichen sprigs and spore points, fixed to the grid so they do not shimmer
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(193,217,139,0.22)';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,231,166,0.24)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.55;
      ctx.beginPath();
      let sprigs = 0;
      for (let y = 2; y < GRID_H - 2 && sprigs < 150; y += 1) {
        for (let x = 2; x < GRID_W - 2 && sprigs < 150; x += 1) {
          const i = y * GRID_W + x;
          const p = sim.plants[i];
          if (p < 0.42) continue;
          const hash = (x * 73856093) ^ (y * 19349663);
          if ((hash & 127) > 2) continue;
          const px = ox + x * s;
          const py = oy + y * s;
          ctx.moveTo(px, py + 1.4);
          ctx.lineTo(px, py - 1.5);
          ctx.moveTo(px, py);
          ctx.lineTo(px - 1.4, py - 1.1);
          ctx.moveTo(px + 0.2, py - 0.4);
          ctx.lineTo(px + 1.5, py - 1.5);
          sprigs++;
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let y = 2; y < GRID_H - 2; y += 3) {
        for (let x = 2; x < GRID_W - 2; x += 3) {
          const i = y * GRID_W + x;
          if (sim.plants[i] < 0.7) continue;
          if (((x * 13 + y * 7) & 31) > 3) continue;
          ctx.rect(ox + x * s, oy + y * s, 0.9, 0.9);
        }
      }
      ctx.fill();

      if (this.terrain) {
        ctx.drawImage(this.terrain, 0, 0, this.terrain.width, this.terrain.height, 0, 0, w, h);
      }

      if (!this.snapshot && w > 430) this.drawScaleBar();

      const alivePrey = [];
      for (const a of sim.prey) if (a.alive) alivePrey.push(a);
      const alivePred = [];
      for (const a of sim.pred) if (a.alive) alivePred.push(a);

      if (this.trace) this.drawTraces(alivePrey, alivePred);
      this.drawPrey(alivePrey);
      this.drawPredators(alivePred);

      if (this.hover && this.hover.alive) this.drawHoverRing(this.hover);
      if (!this.snapshot && this.pointer.active) this.drawLoupe(options);
    }

    drawScaleBar() {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const len = this.scale * 10;
      const x = 16;
      const y = 17;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,201,151,0.35)';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(226,201,151,0.5)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + len, y);
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - 2.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + 2.5);
      ctx.moveTo(x + len, y - 2.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x + len, y + 2.5);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.font = '500 6px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
      ctx.letterSpacing = '1px';
      ctx.fillText('10 CELLS', x, y + 10);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    drawTraces(prey, pred) {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const s = this.scale;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(165,218,203,0.11)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.55;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const a of prey) {
        const x = this.offX + a.x * s;
        const y = this.offY + a.y * s;
        const len = (1.4 + a.genes.speed * 4.2);
        ctx.moveTo(x - Math.cos(a.heading) * len, y - Math.sin(a.heading) * len);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(225,139,105,0.16)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const a of pred) {
        const x = this.offX + a.x * s;
        const y = this.offY + a.y * s;
        const len = (3 + a.genes.speed * 6);
        ctx.moveTo(x - Math.cos(a.heading) * len, y - Math.sin(a.heading) * len);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    drawPrey(list) {
      if (!list.length) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const s = this.scale;
      const ox = this.offX;
      const oy = this.offY;
      const base = Math.max(1.15, Math.min(2.9, s * 0.26));
      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineWidth = base < 1.6 ? 0.65 : 0.8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,224,208,0.84)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const a of list) {
        const r = base * (0.84 + Math.min(0.42, a.energy * 0.18));
        const x = ox + a.x * s;
        const y = oy + a.y * s;
        ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
        ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      if (s > 4.2) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,224,208,0.34)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.45;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (const a of list) {
          const r = base * (0.84 + Math.min(0.42, a.energy * 0.18));
          const x = ox + a.x * s;
          const y = oy + a.y * s;
          const hx = Math.cos(a.heading);
          const hy = Math.sin(a.heading);
          for (const side of [-0.55, 0.55]) {
            const c = Math.cos(a.heading + side);
            const si = Math.sin(a.heading + side);
            ctx.moveTo(x + hx * r * 0.9, y + hy * r * 0.9);
            ctx.lineTo(x + c * r * 2.15, y + si * r * 2.15);
          }
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    drawPredators(list) {
      if (!list.length) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const s = this.scale;
      const ox = this.offX;
      const oy = this.offY;
      const len = Math.max(4.1, Math.min(8.2, s * 0.92));
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(228,148,116,0.94)';
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(7,16,14,0.72)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.55;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const a of list) {
        const x = ox + a.x * s;
        const y = oy + a.y * s;
        const fx = Math.cos(a.heading);
        const fy = Math.sin(a.heading);
        const rx = -fy;
        const ry = fx;
        const half = len * 0.34;
        const tipX = x + fx * len * 0.66;
        const tipY = y + fy * len * 0.66;
        const backX = x - fx * len * 0.46;
        const backY = y - fy * len * 0.46;
        const notchX = x - fx * len * 0.12;
        const notchY = y - fy * len * 0.12;
        ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
        ctx.lineTo(backX + rx * half, backY + ry * half);
        ctx.lineTo(notchX, notchY);
        ctx.lineTo(backX - rx * half, backY - ry * half);
        ctx.closePath();
      }
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,218,190,0.8)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const a of list) {
        const x = ox + a.x * s;
        const y = oy + a.y * s;
        const fx = Math.cos(a.heading);
        const fy = Math.sin(a.heading);
        const hr = Math.max(0.6, len * 0.08);
        ctx.moveTo(x + fx * len * 0.36 + hr, y + fy * len * 0.36);
        ctx.arc(x + fx * len * 0.36, y + fy * len * 0.36, hr, 0, TAU);
      }
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    drawHoverRing(agent) {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const s = this.scale;
      const x = this.offX + agent.x * s;
      const y = this.offY + agent.y * s;
      const isPred = agent.species === 'pred';
      const r = isPred ? 10 : 8;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,201,151,0.88)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,201,151,0.38)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
      ctx.setLineDash([1.4, 2.4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, r + 3.5, 0, TAU);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const ang of [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5]) {
        ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(ang) * (r - 2.2), y + Math.sin(ang) * (r - 2.2));
        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(ang) * (r + 1.6), y + Math.sin(ang) * (r + 1.6));
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    drawLoupe(options) {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const w = this.w;
      const h = this.h;
      const r = Math.max(40, Math.min(62, w * 0.074));
      const cx = clamp(this.pointer.x, r + 6, w - r - 6);
      const cy = clamp(this.pointer.y, r + 6, h - r - 6);
      const zoom = 1.82;
      const dpr = this.dpr;
      this.lastLens = { x: cx, y: cy, r };

Built `index.html` as a single self-contained file. Open it directly: it auto-starts the seeded run, advances to the configured horizon, then transitions into the archive.

The visual direction is a nocturne naturalist’s vitrine: a brass-framed specimen case with stipple lichen, mint moth glyphs, rust hunter darts, and an instrument fascia built into the same body. The brass loupe reveals individual gene vectors; the species legend, timeline, and disturbance switches are part of the apparatus rather than a form beside it.

The simulation layer is DOM-free with a seeded PRNG, deterministic replay, a headless render toggle, and tempos up to ×32. The archive is canvas-drawn: census curves plus a mean ±1σ trait-drift matrix, with catastrophe markers throughout.

Verified at 1440, 1280, 390, and 320 widths, via both HTTP and `file://`, with no console errors and no network requests beyond the file itself.
